Journalist Clayton Morris joins Tucker Carlson to charge that Israel has a sinister agenda to use the US military against Trump's plan for peace. Morris co-hosts the Redacted show and tracks war policy closely. The pair present the tail wagging the dog as a stark, named charge.

Morris lays out the lobbying and pressure he says push Washington toward war. He and Carlson argue that American troops would pay for another country's strategy. They ask why the president's own peace plan faces sabotage from allies. Alarmed and skeptical viewers get a full case on who drives the war drums.
